criteria.text: The chat composer grows taller as the user types multi-line text.
criteria.test_id: issue-1280-c1: multiline typing delegates height growth to native layout without a synthetic content-size event

criteria.text: The chat composer grows up to a 132pt cap, then switches to internal scrolling.
criteria.test_id: issue-1280-c2: a long draft keeps the intrinsic 132pt cap and native scrolling without a synthetic content-size event

criteria.text: A human must confirm on a real iPhone before this is called done.
